name: Warrington

licensing.additional: No additional HMO licensing scheme; only larger HMOs need a mandatory licence. Separately, a borough-wide Article 4 Direction approved by Cabinet on 9 June 2026 (in force by the end of September 2026) means planning permission is needed to turn a family home into an HMO.

neighbourhoods.name: Warrington town centre and Bank Quay
neighbourhoods.housing: Victorian terraces, flats over shops and newer apartment blocks near the stations.

neighbourhoods.name: Orford and Bewsey
neighbourhoods.housing: Older terraced streets and post-war council-built estates, many now privately let.

neighbourhoods.name: Birchwood
neighbourhoods.housing: A new-town district of 1970s and 1980s estates of terraced and semi-detached houses.

neighbourhoods.name: Great Sankey and Penketh
neighbourhoods.housing: Mostly 1970s to 1990s estates of semi-detached and detached family homes.

neighbourhoods.name: Lymm

neighbourhoods.name: Culcheth and Croft

housing: Warrington grew from a Victorian industrial town into a new town in the 1970s and 1980s, so its housing ranges from central terraces in Orford, Bewsey and Latchford to new-town estates at Birchwood, Westbrook and Great Sankey. Private renting grew faster than England's average between 2011 and 2021, with lets concentrated near the centre and in former council homes. South Warrington, around Stockton Heath, Appleton and Lymm, is more expensive and mostly owner-occupied. The council has introduced a borough-wide planning control on new HMOs.
checkinTips: Victorian terraces in Orford, Latchford and Bewsey: photograph back yards, rear walls and any damp low on the walls.
New-town estate homes in Birchwood and Westbrook: check shared paths, garages in blocks, flat roofs and window seals.
Apartments near Bank Quay and Central stations: record fob and key counts, parking, bin store access and the intercom handset.
Canal-side homes in Lymm and near the Ship Canal: check ground floors and walls for damp and note any mooring or garden access rules.
Family homes in Great Sankey and Appleton: photograph gardens, fences, sheds and garage doors as lets often include them.
tenantHelp: Private tenants can contact Warrington Borough Council's private sector housing team about disrepair, damp or unsafe conditions.
